pyFBS.utility¶

pyFBS.modeshape_sync_lstsq(mode_shape_vec)[source]¶

Creates a straight line fit in the complex plane and alligns the mode shape with the real-axis.

Parameters

mode_shape_vec (array(float)) – Mode shape vector

Return _n

Alligned mode shape vector

Scales mode shapes according to the driving point measurement.

Parameters

  • mode_shape_vec (array(float)) – Mode shape vector

  • driving_point (int) – Driving point location

  • sync (bool, optional) – Allign mode shape with the real-axis

Returns

Scalled mode shape

  • Y –

Creates an animation sequence from the mode shape and scales the displacemetns.

pyFBS.coh_frf(y_1, y_2)[source]¶

Calculates values of coherence between two FRFs.

Parameters

  • y_1 (array(float)) – FRF 1

  • y_2 (array(float)) – FRF 2

Returns

coherence criterion

pyFBS.dict_animation(_modeshape, a_type, mesh=None, pts=None, fps=30, r_scale=10, no_points=60, object_list=None)[source]¶

Creates a predefined dictionary for animation sequency in the 3D display.

Parameters

  • _modeshape (array(float)) – A mode shape or response to be animated

  • a_type (str) – Animation type (“modeshape” or “object”)

  • mesh (array(float), optional) – Mesh to be animated

  • pts (array(float), optional) – Points to be animated

  • fps (int, optional) – Frames per second of the animation

  • r_scale (float, optional) – Relative scale of the displacement

  • no_points (int, optional) – Number of points in the animation sequence

  • object_list (list, optional) – A list containing objects to be animated

Returns

CMIF parameters (singular values with or without left and right singular vectors)

pyFBS.TSVD(matrix, reduction=0)[source]¶

Filters a FRF matrix with a truncated singular value decomposition (TSVD) by removing the smallest singular values.

Parameters

  • matrix (array(float)) – Matrix to be filtered by singular value decomposition

  • reduction (int, optional) – Number of singular values not taken into account by reconstruction of the matrix

Returns

Filtered matrix

Return type

array(float)

pyFBS.generate_channels_from_sensors(df)[source]¶

Generates a set of channels based on the orientation of sensors. CUrrent implementation assumes that each sensor has three channels (i.e. tri-axial sensors).

Parameters

df (pd.DataFrame) – A DataFrame containing information on sensors

Returns

A DataFrame containing information on channels

pyFBS.generate_sensors_from_channels(df)[source]¶

Generates a set of sensors based on the supplied channel data. CUrrent implementation assumes that each sensor has three channels (i.e. tri-axial sensors).

Parameters

df (pd.DataFrame) – A DataFrame containing information on channels

Returns

A DataFrame containing information on sensors
